summary: Tonight, 2026-09-26, is Push A, the last night of the deload week. Nothing has been logged since yesterday's panel: the newest file is still 2026-09-24 LegsB, and 2026-09-25 was a rest day. So there is no new fact, and I hold yesterday's stance on every lift: hold, no sets, no vetoes. I re-read the raw logs for 2026-09-22 (PushB), 2026-09-23 (PullB) and 2026-09-24 (LegsB) by hand. None of them has a single note, and none has a bodyweight. The only line the pain search flags in the whole log is from 2026-08-23, and it is a question about set count, not a pain report. His push muscles were last trained on 2026-09-22, four days before tonight. His last logged bodyweight is still 207 lb on 2026-08-23, now 34 days old. I see no grounds for a veto.
